decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed single storey detached outbuilding would be acceptable due to its position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, or neighbours' living conditions and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development)and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the information given in the submitted drawings, the out building shall be finished in red sand faced fletton brickwork, to match the existing garage at No. 100 Catherine Gardens, and interlocking concrete tiles.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the out building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached outbuilding shall only be used by a resident of the property for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of 96 Catherine Gardens, including a private office for the occupier of the house alone, and for no other purpose. It shall not be used as separate living accommodation and shall not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities.
Condition : 7 - No staff shall be employed in the building.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to rear of house for use as an office
